messages:
Sara: Heads-up — noticed a token spike tied to the new priority-route hedging rollout. customer-42 invoice preview shows a ~2x token bump between 02:16-02:18 UTC. Looks like fallback requests are being counted twice in the metering pipeline.
Devin: ugh. is that from the early-bailover path? which stage is double-emitting — ingress or aggregator?
Sara: initial hypothesis: the router emits a fallback event AND the fallback target emits its own token event, so both reach ingest before dedupe. snippet from the proxy logs: 
```
{route_id: "r-priority-7", fallback: true, req_id: "rx-9f3", tokens: 412}
{route_id: "r-fallback-low", emitted_by: "router", ref: "rx-9f3", tokens: 412}
```
Chun: confirmed on telemetry — dashboard shows twin spikes with identical req_id pattern. the dedupe window is 30s; these landed ~200ms apart and slipped through because they have different source tags.
Maria: that explains why console invoice preview shows a bump when hedging is on. current rollout UI only toggles feature flags, no per-route preview of estimated metering delta. we should add a quick heuristic preview before flipping hedging globally.
Devin: short-term mitigation: can we add a router-side tag normalization so both events get the same dedupe key? Or set the aggregator to prefer router-origin events when present?
Kevin: aggregator change sounds heavier; router tag normalization is smaller. but be careful — some downstream consumers rely on source_tag to attribute cost to model variants.
ops-bot: ALERT billing-bot detected invoice-delta anomaly for tenant customer-42, delta=+10234 tokens, severity=medium. ticket=INC-4823
Chun: what about increasing dedupe window to 2s? that would catch these, but risks merging legitimately separate retries during bursts.
Sara: agree. we should avoid broad heuristics that mask real duplicates elsewhere. proposal: (1) router adds field dedupe_key = sha1(req_id + route_family) (2) aggregator uses dedupe_key if present. That keeps attribution intact.
Devin: sounds good. can we dogfood that in a canary pool first? toggle in console per-pool and run for 1h.
Maria: I can add a per-route "metering-preview" card to the rollout modal: shows expected token delta with hedging on/off. quick mock: a small table with recent 1h traffic, projected tokens, and a risk score.
Kevin: if we change dedupe semantics we should also run a reconciliation job for the 02:16-02:18 window to fix invoices. I'll schedule a short backfill to mark duplicates and emit corrected credit adjustments.
Sara: ok action list: 1) Devin/Chun — router dedupe_key patch + canary config (dev pool) 2) Maria — add metering-preview card to rollout modal (opt-in flag) 3) Kevin — run recon job for affected window and prepare adjustment patch 4) Ops — mute global hedging rollout until canary green.
Devin: i'll open a PR for router tag normalization and add tests for dedupe_key generation.
Chun: i'll wire aggregator to prefer dedupe_key when present and add a unit test for same-req different-source cases.
Maria: will put a small UX stub in the console that reads sampling stats API and projects costs. leaving as opt-in for now. link to draft doc: https://redwood.company/s/roadmap/metering-preview (internal)
Kevin: created INC-4823-recon and BILL-4823-adjustment drafts, scheduling run at 04:00 UTC.
Sara: thanks all. please post canary results in this thread. :thumbsup:
Devin: noted — will post results + PR link.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary deployment started for r-priority-7 -> pool dev-canary at 03:10 UTC.
Sara: nice — keep an eye on the console preview and the billing alert.
Devin: PR: https://git.redwood/s/platform/router/pulls/578 - adds dedupe_key and unit tests.
Chun: aggregator patch in review, PR: https://git.redwood/s/platform/aggregator/pulls/210
Maria: UX PR opened for rollout metering-preview: https://git.redwood/s/console/ui/pulls/92
Kevin: recon run completed, initial diff shows ~-10k tokens corrected for customer-42. pushing adjustment to staging invoices.
Sara: Good progress. Follow-ups: once patches merged we should run a 24h shadow canary (no billing changes) to validate no other regressions.
Devin: agreed. will coordinate schedule and update this thread.
